source_text: Paulus servus Jesu Christi. Requiramus cur servus dicatur is qui alibi scribit: Non enim accepistis spiritum servitutis iterum in timore, sed accepistis spiritum adoptionis. Cum liber sim ab omnibus, omnibus me servum feci. Servit ergo Christo non in spiritu servitutis sed in spiritu adoptionis, quia omni libertate nobilior est servitus Christi. Gloria Christo. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Paul, servant of Jesus Christ. Let us ask why he is called servant who elsewhere writes: For you did not receive a spirit of slavery again in fear, but you received a spirit of adoption. Though I am free from all, I made myself a servant to all. Therefore he serves Christ not in a spirit of slavery but in a spirit of adoption, because Christ’s service is nobler than every freedom. Glory to Christ. Amen.
pass_b_english: [[Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ >> Bible:Romans 1:1]] — yet he also wrote [[you received a spirit of adoption >> Bible:Romans 8:15]]. Free from all, he [[made himself a servant to all >> Bible:1 Corinthians 9:19]], imitating the Lord who [[took the form of a servant >> Bible:Philippians 2:7]]. Slavery to Christ outranks every liberty. Glory to Christ. Amen.
notes: True OET; no Scheck FOTC Romans.
